component.name: Segmenta
component.summary: Fast segmented download manager for GNOME

description.p: Segmenta downloads HTTP and HTTPS files with several connections at once, writes every byte directly at its final offset and keeps the state in SQLite so a download survives a pause, a crash or a reboot.
Connections are split in hot during the transfer: when a worker finishes its range it takes over half of the slowest remaining range instead of sitting idle.
Direct downloads only: HLS/DASH, DRM-protected streams and the browser capture extension are planned for later releases.
First public release: segmented direct downloads, pause/resume across daemon restarts, CLI and GTK4/Libadwaita GUI, .deb package with systemd user units.
